desc: Ideate: reduce to enumerating the smaller side m=min(K,N-K) because C(N,K)=C(N,m)<=10^6.
Implement direct enumeration solution in Python with stdin/stdout and required code delimiters.
Verify samples and edge cases: K=1, K=N, m=0, duplicate values, and largest feasible combination count near 10^6.
